post.summary: (BETA) Collect physical table and column statistics from a StarRocks data source
post.description: (BETA) Reads pre-computed CBO statistics from StarRocks. Supports both internal catalog (native/PIPE tables) and external catalog (Iceberg tables). Statistics include row counts, data sizes, NDV (number of distinct values), null counts, and min/max values.
It executes SQL query against specified data source and extracts metadata. Metadata consist of column names and column data types. It can optionally provide also preview of data returned by SQL query

An example of a successful scan.description: An example of a successful scan

x-gdc-security-info.description: Minimal permission required to use this endpoint.

post.summary: Scan a database to get a physical data model (PDM)
post.description: It scans a database and transforms its metadata to a declarative definition of the physical data model (PDM). The result of the request contains the mentioned physical data model (PDM) of a database within warning, for example, about unsupported columns.

dataSize.description: Total data size of the column in bytes.

ndv.description: NDV (Number of Distinct Values) — approximate cardinality of the column.

nullCount.description: Number of NULL values in the column.

ColumnStatisticsRequest.description: A request to retrieve statistics for a column.

message.description: Warning message related to the column.

DataSourceParameter.description: A parameter for testing data source connection

DataSourceSchemata.description: Result of getSchemata. Contains list of available DB schema names.

isPrimaryKey.description: Is column part of primary key?

name.description: Column name. Must not contain NUL (0x00) characters.

nullValue.description: Value used as sentinel for nullable columns

namePrefix.description: Table or view name prefix used in scan. Will be stripped when generating LDM.

tables.description: An array of physical database tables.

valueLimit.description: The maximum number of distinct values to return.

scanTables.description: A flag indicating whether the tables should be scanned.

scanViews.description: A flag indicating whether the views should be scanned.

separator.description: A separator between prefixes and the names.

tablePrefix.description: Tables starting with this prefix will be scanned. The prefix is then followed by the value of `separator` parameter. Given the table prefix is `out_table` and separator is `__`, the table with name like `out_table__customers` will be scanned.

viewPrefix.description: Views starting with this prefix will be scanned. The prefix is then followed by the value of `separator` parameter. Given the view prefix is `out_view` and separator is `__`, the table with name like `out_view__us_customers` will be scanned.

ScanRequest.description: A request containing all information critical to model scanning.

ScanResultPdm.description: Result of scan of data source physical model.

sql.example: SELECT a.special_value as result FROM tableA a

ScanSqlRequest.description: A request with SQL query to by analyzed.

dataPreview.description: Array of rows where each row is another array of string values.

ScanSqlResponse.description: Result of scanSql. Consists of array of query columns including type. Sql query result data preview can be attached optionally

nullValue.description: Value used as sentinel for null values in the column

dataSize.description: Total data size of the table in bytes.

rowCount.description: Total number of rows in the table.

message.description: Warning message related to the table.
